author: Megan Southall
title: Paul Sherry Industrial Park expands with new buildings - NewsBreak
text:
By Megan Southall ,
4 hours ago
PIQUA, Ohio ( WDTN ) – The Paul Sherry Industrial Park has announced a new expansion, adding seven new buildings for manufacturing, warehousing, and more.
According to our partners at Miami Valley Today, the project will include the addition of three 5,000-square-foot buildings, two 10,560-square-foot buildings, and two 20,000-square-foot buildings.
Each facility is being developed as a move-in-ready space and will feature offices, modern utilities, and flexible layouts.
“We have seen sustained demand for speculative industrial space in Piqua and throughout the region,” said Michael Sherry.
Construction began in early 2026 and is expected to be completed by early 2027.
